Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the recap — that looks right. A couple of clarifications from Procurement: 
- For pilots under $25k we typically allow a corporate card; anything above that needs a PO and three-week lead time for approvals.
- Marketplace purchases (AWS Marketplace preferred) are often faster because Finance treats them as SaaS subscriptions, but there are limits on contract customizations.
- Our security review requires SOC2 Type II and a link to your data retention and audit logging docs.

I'll also loop in procurement@acmehealth.com so they have visibility. If you could send a quote that shows a pilot (month-to-month on-demand) price and a 12-month committed price (with any committed discount), that would help our finance case.

Hi all — thanks Marissa and Susan. Quick summary of recommended commercial/packaging options based on Acme's constraints: 

1) Pilot (fast path, < $25k): Hosted API, month-to-month on-demand (card ok)
   - Why: fastest to get live, no infra procurement, immediate onboarding.
   - Pricing: standard on-demand rates. Well provide a quote in the attached pricing sheet showing estimated monthly spend for expected QPS and token volumes.

2) Production (predictable throughput / higher volume): Dedicated (reserved GPU capacity) with a 12-month commit purchased via PO
   - Why: predictable performance and unit economics at scale; isolation for regulated data if needed.
   - Commit bands: 500k tokens/month, 2M tokens/month, 10M tokens/month (example bands). Each band has progressively larger discounts vs on-demand.
   - Minimums / lead time: Dedicated requires ~4-6 weeks lead time for capacity provisioning in most regions; PO timeline aligns with your procurement window.

3) Private (VPC / on-prem): Only recommended if your regulator requires customer-managed networking or air-gap. This path carries ops overhead and often needs a separate enterprise agreement. If Acme needs this, we can scope it with SOW (longer timeline).

Marketplace note: AWS/Azure Marketplace is supported for hosted commits (SaaS) — it smooths Finance approval but limits certain contract edits (we can offer standard marketplace terms or do a direct PO if custom legal terms are required).

Attachments included: redwood_pricing_sheet_v3.pdf (pilot vs commit scenarios), acme_po_template.docx (sample PO flow), example SOW bullets for Private (see acme_sow_requirements.pdf previously shared).

Next steps:
- Marissa: send a one-page quote for the pilot (on-demand) and an illustrative 12-month commit quote for the Recommended Dedicated band (we can pick the 2M tokens/month band unless Acme prefers a different baseline).
- Susan / Procurement: once you confirm Marketplace vs direct PO preference, we will finalize pricing and legal routing.

Happy to jump on a short call to walk procurement through the differences and timelines — I can be available Wed/Thu afternoon.

Thanks,
